title: Senior Accountant
why_it_fits: Accounting & Bookkeeping match. 1 skills: excel. Yes PH eligibility signal
why_it_might_not: Senior level may require stronger proof. Salary not disclosed
position_overview:
Job Description:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and driven Senior Accountant to join our team. The Senior Accountant will independently manage general ledger activity, reconciliations, and financial reporting, while owning key components of the month-end and year-end close process. The ideal candidate has a strong command of accounting principles and regulations, sound technical judgment, and the ability to work independently while providing guidance to junior accounting staff.
key_responsibilities:
Own and review journal entries in the general ledger, ensuring accuracy and completeness

Lead monthly bank and balance sheet reconciliations, resolving complex discrepancies

Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements

Analyze financial data and provide variance explanations and recommendations to management

Lead the budgeting and forecasting processes for assigned properties or business units

Prepare and organize documentation for external audits, and serve as a point of contact for auditors

Provide technical accounting guidance and review work performed by Staff Accountants

Identify and implement process improvements that strengthen internal controls

Support accounts payable and accounts receivable functions as needed, particularly for escalated or complex items

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance

CPA certification or actively pursuing CPA strongly preferred

Solid experience in property management / residential / hotel business is a plus
- Hotel Experience is priority

Strong technical knowledge of bank reconciliation, balance sheet reconciliation, and other account reconciliations

Strong understanding of Accounts Receivable and / or Accounts Payable

Preferably 5 to 8+ years of relevant accounting experience

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software (experience with [specific software] is a plus)

Hands-on experience owning end to end accounting, from journal entries through month end close and preparation of financial reports

Strong understanding of accounting principles and regulations, with the judgment to apply them independently

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills

Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively across multiple properties or business units

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including experience mentoring or reviewing the work of junior staff

Ability to work independently and lead within a team environment

Why you'll love it here?
- Free lunch meals, fruits, snacks, and beverages for employees assigned to onsite shifts.
- Access to an onsite gym with a complimentary professional fitness instructor.
- Weekly fitness activities and an annual fitness challenge with prizes of up to 70,000.
- Weekly employee engagement activities with prizes of up to 3,000.
- Free upskilling academy to support career growth and professional development.
- State-of-the-art office facilities and modern workstations.
- Access to employee amenities including sleeping quarters, game area, chat room, and shower rooms.
- Fun, collaborative, and employee-focused work environment.
